title: linaria genistifolia subsp. dalmatica
intro: Linaria genistifolia subsp. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian toadflax, is a flowering plant species within the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian toadflax include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antiviral and antifungal activities. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
